title: Patch: the changed-cards fuzz rotation plays the Duos wave too

**Issue #4369 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4369: Patch: the changed-cards fuzz rotation plays the Duos wave too
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

When a pull request changes a card, the fuzz gate already replays that card in extra forced one-on-one games before merge, so a regression in the card is caught the same day. It never does the same for team games: a card that only breaks through a four-seat game (the shared team pool, passes between teammates, concede offers, four mulligans) is dealt only by chance, and a miss waits for the next daily run. After this change, a card change also gets a small bounded set of forced team games on the same pull request.

## Why

- `run()` in the fuzz CLI returns early for `--duos`, before the changed-cards wave; the manual flags refuse the combination too (`--cards` lists `duos` in its conflicts), so even by hand nobody can force cards into Duos games today.
- `play_changed_cards` plays a 1v1 forced wave, a Radiant rotation and changed fused pairs, all one-on-one; the Duos wave has its own endings channel, probes and growth bounds, i.e. the repository already treats team games as a distinct failure domain, but changed cards never enter it per pull request.
- No card script reads team state today, so the risk is not card text branching on teams: it is card hooks meeting engine paths that only exist with four seats (damage routed through the team pool, extra seats owing prompts, concede offers mid-game). Those paths are exactly what random daily deals may never hit for a given card before it merges.
- This does not repeat #1363 (a pinned Duos failure corpus, closed unbuilt): it adds no corpus files and pins no past failure; and it does not repeat #4146 (rejected): no browser is involved.

## Proposal

- Lift the `--cards`/`--duos` conflict so `fuzz --duos --cards <ids>` forces cards into Duos decks, the same way it does for one-on-one decks; keep `--radiant` conflicting with `--duos`, since the Radiant rotation plays run-start games with deck marks and team games have no such path.
- Apply the existing forcing (each token resolved to its carrier, sets dealt several cards a seed) to the four Duos seats' decks, and play a bounded changed-Duos rotation inside `play_changed_cards` with its own summary and coverage lines, capped by new named constants sized for the heavier four-seat games.
- Update the `jackioh-tools` README command table in the same pull request (the acceptance test holds the table to the CLI, so it fails otherwise).

## Where it lands

- `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` (wave orchestration, forcing, new bounds), `crates/tools/src/duos_fuzz.rs` (forced Duos decks), `crates/tools/README.md` (command table) and its holding test `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs`.
- SPEC §10.7 (the fuzz gate) and SPEC §13 (team games).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `cargo jackioh fuzz --duos --cards <a changed card>` plays Duos games with that card forced into the seats' decks and reports a `changed cards` line; without `--cards` the wave is unchanged.
- [ ] A pull request that changes a card plays the bounded Duos rotation after the 1v1 one, and a seed it fails names the seed, the teams and a `reproduce:` line that replays it.
- [ ] A change with no deckable card still plays nothing extra, and `--radiant --duos` is still refused with the usage error.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-tools` passes, including the acceptance test over the README table.

## Size and risks

Medium: a few hundred lines, mostly the Duos forcing path and its tests. The risk is per-pull-request time (team games cost more than one-on-one ones, and the CI job has an eight-minute budget): keep the new seed cap small and count the rotation's seconds in the pull request. No workflow changes are needed.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44866333929)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Let `cargo jackioh fuzz --duos --cards <ids>` force cards into all four Duos seats' decks, and make the pull-request gate play a small bounded changed-Duos rotation after the 1v1 changed-cards wave. A Duos seed failure names the seed, the teams, and a `reproduce:` line that replays it; `--radiant --duos` stays refused; a change with no deckable card plays nothing extra.

## Files to touch

| Path | New / change | What changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` | change | `Args::cards` conflict list, `Args` docs, `CHANGED_DUOS_DEALS_PER_CARD` / `CHANGED_DUOS_MAX_SEEDS` consts, `Forcing::deal_duos`, `summary_line`/`json` to `pub(crate)`, `run()` duos branch, `play_changed_duos_rotation`, module docs, one clap test |
| `crates/tools/src/duos_fuzz.rs` | change | `&Forcing` params on `run`/`play_duos_wave`/`failure_lines`/`summary`/`wave_json`, `duos_options_for_seed_forced`, `played` tracking on `DuosRun`/`DuosSeedOutcome`, `duos_coverage_line`, `reproduce:` line in `failure_report`, module docs, new and updated tests |
| `crates/tools/README.md` | change | Duos command-table row gains `[--cards ids\|set]`; bare-gate paragraph names the Duos rotation |
| `spec/13-duos.md` | change | 1–2 sentences on the changed-Duos rotation beside the existing `fuzz --duos` mention |
| `spec/10-engine-guide.md`, `crates/engine`, `crates/cards`, `crates/ai`, `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/` | must not touch | §10.7 documents randomness/scorers, not the gate (no such spec section exists); acceptance test must pass unmodified; harness paths are forbidden |

No ruling note and no `spec/pending/4369.md`: this decides no game rule (tooling only; Hearthstone has no fuzz gate, so CLAUDE.md rule 3 mints nothing).

## Steps

1. `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs`, `Args::cards`: change `conflicts_with_all = ["duos", "regress"]` to `["regress"]`. Update its doc comment to say the ids go into both decks of every 1v1 seed and into all four seats' decks of every Duos seed (`--duos`). Leave `radiant`'s `conflicts_with_all = ["handicap", "duos", "regress"]` exactly as is.
2. `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs`, after `CHANGED_RADIANT_MAX_SEEDS`: add `pub const CHANGED_DUOS_DEALS_PER_CARD: u32 = 4;` and `pub const CHANGED_DUOS_MAX_SEEDS: u32 = 16;`, each with a doc comment in the style of the lines above (small because four-seat games cost more than 1v1 ones).
3. `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs`, `impl Forcing`: add `pub(crate) fn deal_duos(&self, seed: u32, decks: DuosDecks) -> DuosDecks` applying `force_into` to each seat's deck (`a1`, `a2`, `b1`, `b2`), returning `decks` untouched when `self.for_seed(seed)` is empty so a wave without `--cards` deals exactly today's decks and draws no extra rng. Change `fn summary_line` and `fn json` to `pub(crate)`. `DuosDecks` is already imported.
4. `crates/tools/src/duos_fuzz.rs`, options: add `fn duos_options_for_seed_forced(seed: u32, forcing: &crate::fuzz::Forcing) -> DuosCreateOptions` — today's body, but decks come from `duos_decks_for_handicaps` with each seat forced via `crate::golden::force_into(&deck, &forcing.for_seed(seed))`. Keep `duos_options_for_seed(seed)` as a wrapper passing `&Forcing::default()`. Import `Forcing`, `force_into`, `GameEvent`, `DuosEvent`, `IndexSet`.
5. `crates/tools/src/duos_fuzz.rs`, played tracking: add `played: IndexSet<String>` to `DuosRun` and to `DuosSeedOutcome`. Add `fn note_duos_played(played: &mut IndexSet<String>, events: &[DuosEvent])` inserting the `def_id` of every `DuosEvent::Duel` whose inner event is `CardPlayed`, `TrapFired`, or `CardAnnounced` (mirrors 1v1 `note_played`). Call it on `begun.events` at setup and on every step's `result.events` in `play_duos_game_inner`; carry `run.played` into the outcome in `fuzz_duos_seed` (empty on failure/panic).
6. `crates/tools/src/duos_fuzz.rs`, signatures: `run(from, seeds, json, forcing: &Forcing)`, `play_duos_wave(from, ran, forcing: &Forcing)`, `fuzz_duos_seed(seed, forcing: &Forcing)` (via `play_duos_game_from` with `duos_options_for_seed_forced`), `failure_report(seed, error, forcing)`, `failure_lines(outcomes, forcing)`, `summary(from, ran, outcomes, forcing)`, `wave_json(from, ran, outcomes, forcing)`. Keep `fuzz_duos_seed(seed)` and `play_duos_game(seed)` as default-forcing wrappers so behavior without cards is byte-identical. `failure_report` prints decks from the forced options and, when `forcing.for_seed(seed)` is non-empty, `forced:` plus `reproduce: cargo jackioh fuzz --duos --from {seed} --seeds 1 --cards {ids}` lines. `summary` appends `forcing.summary_line()` and the new coverage line; `wave_json` adds `"forced": forcing.json()`, per-failure `"forced"` ids, and options from the forced seed.
7. `crates/tools/src/duos_fuzz.rs`, coverage: add `pub(crate) fn duos_coverage_line(outcomes: &[DuosSeedOutcome], forcing: &Forcing) -> String` — dealt is the union of the four seats' decks recomputed per outcome seed via `duos_options_for_seed_forced` (deterministic, no stored decks needed), played is the union of outcomes' `played`; print `coverage: {never} of {dealt} dealt pool cards never played: {shown}` with `COVERAGE_SHOWN` truncation in `Coverage::shown`'s style (import `COVERAGE_SHOWN` from `crate::fuzz`).
8. `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs`, `run()`: in the `args.duos` branch, build `let forcing = Forcing::from_cards(&args.cards)?;` and call `crate::duos_fuzz::run(from, args.seeds, args.json, &forcing)`. `plays_changed` stays unchanged (bare gate only).
9. `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs`, `play_changed_cards`: after `play_radiant_rotation` inside the `forcing.cards` non-empty branch, add `failed.extend(play_changed_duos_rotation(&forcing));`. Add `fn play_changed_duos_rotation(forcing: &Forcing) -> Vec<String>`: `seeds = rotation_seeds(forcing.cards.len(), forcing.per_seed, CHANGED_DUOS_DEALS_PER_CARD).min(CHANGED_DUOS_MAX_SEEDS)`; print `changed cards (Duos): {n} forced ({per} a seed) over seeds 1..{seeds}: {ids}`; `let wave = crate::duos_fuzz::play_duos_wave(1, seeds, forcing)`; print `summary` plus failures report; return the failure message `the changed cards' Duos rotation: {n} of {seeds} seeds failed` when non-empty. Update the `#3113` module-docs paragraph to name the Duos rotation after the Radiant one.
10. `crates/tools/README.md`: change the duos table row to `` `fuzz --duos [--from N] [--seeds N] [--cards ids\|set] [--json]` `` and extend the bare-gate paragraph (`Bare (no --from, --handicap, --cards or --json)…`) with one sentence: after the Radiant rotation it plays the changed-Duos rotation (`CHANGED_DUOS_DEALS_PER_CARD` games each, at most `CHANGED_DUOS_MAX_SEEDS` seeds, forced into all four seats' decks).
11. `spec/13-duos.md`: beside the paragraph citing `cargo jackioh fuzz --duos`, add that a pull request changing cards also plays a bounded rotation with those cards forced into all four seats' decks. No `[[R…]]` links, no rule prose.
12. Tests: update existing `duos_fuzz.rs` callers for new params (`a_duos_smoke_wave…`, `a_failure_names…`, `r3731002…` (unchanged, uses wrappers), channel test, `assert_caught`, heaviest test — pass `&Forcing::default()`; add `played: IndexSet::new()` to the two hand-built `DuosSeedOutcome`s). Add: forced-decks test (all four seats hold the forced card; default forcing equals today's decks); forced-failure reproduce test (planted growth via a new `fuzz_duos_seed_with_forced` wrapper, assert `setup:`, `reproduce: cargo jackioh fuzz --duos --from 7 --seeds 1 --cards …`); rotation-math test (`rotation_seeds(1,1,CHANGED_DUOS_DEALS_PER_CARD)>0`, capped by `CHANGED_DUOS_MAX_SEEDS`, `CHANGED_DUOS_MAX_SEEDS <= CHANGED_WAVE_MAX_SEEDS`); one-seed forced wave test (`play_duos_wave(1, 1, &forcing)` passes, decks hold the card, summary holds the forced line); `fuzz.rs` clap test (`--cards x --duos` parses, `--radiant --duos` errors) following the `sweep.rs`/`classify.rs` `try_parse_from` pattern.

## Tests

- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools duos` — all Duos fuzz tests, new and updated.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools fuzz` — gate tests incl. the clap conflict test.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools` — full tools suite, including `readme_the_command_table_is_the_clis` over the edited README table.
- `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check` (spec prose touched, no ruling ids added).
- Once, manually: `cargo jackioh fuzz --duos --from 1 --seeds 1 --cards core-090` — expect a passing one-seed wave whose summary names the forced card.

## Done when

- [ ] `fuzz --duos --cards <id>` forces the card into all four seats' decks and the summary carries the forced line; bare `--duos` output is unchanged.
- [ ] A card-changing PR plays the bounded Duos rotation after the 1v1 wave; a failing seed names seed, teams, and a working `reproduce:` line; no-deckable-card changes play nothing extra.
- [ ] `--radiant --duos` is still refused with the usage error.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-tools` green (acceptance incl.), fmt/clippy/spec-check clean.

## Risks

- PR time budget: Duos games cost more than 1v1; the 4-games-each / 16-seed caps keep the rotation to seconds. If CI timing shows otherwise, lower the caps, never the wave's checks.
- Determinism: forcing must draw no rng and reorder only by `force_into` (forced ids first); the empty-forcing path must stay exactly today's deal, or every Duos seed's hash moves.
- Duos coverage understates like 1v1 `Coverage` (played means an event named it, not every hook ran); the line mirrors that caveat, it never fails a seed.
- `spec check` reads `[[…]]` links and R-ids: the spec edit adds neither.

## Open questions

None.
```

- [ ] `fuzz --duos --cards <id>` forces the card into all four seats' decks and the summary carries the forced line; bare `--duos` output is unchanged.

- [ ] `--radiant --duos` is still refused with the usage error.

- `spec check` reads `[[…]]` links and R-ids: the spec edit adds neither.

None.
